Transport & itineraries · Ellora Cave 16

Getting to Kailasa Temple from Sambhajinagar Airport

An airport visit is a two-stage journey: airport to the city gateway, then the road onward to the Ellora Caves at Verul.

Google Maps ↗ ASI source listing ↗

Independent guide · Page reviewed 9 November 2026 · ASI listing consulted 2026-10-29

Kailasa Temple (Cave 16) is one monument within the UNESCO-listed Ellora Caves. Prices, opening status and routes are dated listings to re-check, not live confirmations.

  1. Kailasa Temple Verul
  2. Transport & itineraries
  3. Getting to Kailasa Temple from Sambhajinagar Airport

Two separate legs

Treat the airport-to-city leg and the city-to-Ellora leg as separate decisions. Confirm flight arrival time, the onward vehicle, where it will wait, and how the return is arranged before you commit to a visit on the same day.

ASI places the Ellora complex roughly 30 km north-northwest of the city it calls Aurangabad, now also called Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. That is a regional description, not a measured airport-to-gate distance.

What this guide does not publish

Airport transfer operators, fares, fixed journey times, flight schedules and shuttle availability have not been independently verified here, so none are listed. Check current services directly and agree the price before departure.

  • Confirm the airport’s current name and code when booking.
  • Check the ASI visiting window and weekly Tuesday closure against your flight time.
  • Allow separately for admission and walking inside the property.
  • Carry water and sun protection; exposed stone surfaces can be hot.

If the same-day plan is tight

Because ASI lists sunrise-to-sunset visiting, a late arrival can leave too little daylight. Consider staying in the city and visiting the next morning instead; the where-to-stay page compares the two base areas without naming unverified hotels.

Reviewed 9 November 2026. No transfer times, prices or operator names are claimed.

Frequently asked questions

Is there a direct airport bus to Ellora?

This guide has not verified any direct service. Check current airport and local transport options and see the travel services page.

Can I visit Kailasa Temple on my arrival day?

Only if the daylight visiting window, weekly closure and transfer time all align. Confirm opening status with ASI before planning around a flight.

How long does the transfer take?

No journey time is published here because it has not been independently verified. Agree an estimate with your transport provider.

Sources and review limits

Page reviewed 9 November 2026. The ASI Ellora Caves page was consulted 2026-10-29; that review is not an on-site inspection, and no clear page-update date was visible on the ASI listing. A Google Maps snapshot or a UNESCO property coordinate is not a verified entrance, ticket counter or accessibility survey.

  • Archaeological Survey of India: Ellora Caves — identity, historical attribution, listed opening hours and admission categories.
  • UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Ellora Caves — the 1983 inscription, the ensemble and its artistic significance.
  • ASI official ticket service — check the actual visit date, eligibility and current charge.
  • Google Maps: Kailasa Temple — dated manual snapshot, not site-collected reviews.

No business name, price, timetable, distance, star rating or review score is published here without verification. Temporary closures, conservation work and special orders may override any general listing.
